name: POS User Signature
description: The POS Signature module enhances Odoo Point of Sale by allowing cashiers or customers to draw and save digital signatures directly from the POS interface.
summary: The POS Signature module for Odoo 18 enhances your Point of Sale workflow by introducing secure and convenient digital signature capture. It eliminates the need for paper-based confirmations and improves accountability across your sales and service processes. Designed for retailers, restaurants, and service providers, this app ensures that every transaction can be validated with a legally binding digital signature. Once installed, the module integrates seamlessly into Odoo’s POS system without requiring complicated setup. Administrators can configure signature options under Point of Sale - Settings, where toggles allow you to enable User Signature, Signature with Name, and Signature Display on Receipts. These flexible settings allow you to tailor the feature to your operational needs, whether you want signatures for every transaction or only for specific cases. During a transaction, cashiers can quickly access the Add Signature button in the POS interface. A smooth, user-friendly signature pad pops up, enabling customers or users to draw their signature and enter their name directly on the screen. This interactive step adds a professional touch to your checkout process while ensuring that all approvals are properly documented. name: Custom Discounts for Point of Sale
description: Easily apply and manage custom discounts directly in your Odoo POS. This module empowers cashiers and managers to offer flexible price reductions, track discount reasons, and enhance customer satisfaction
summary: The POS Custom Discount app for Odoo is a powerful and user-friendly extension designed to give businesses more flexibility and control over discount management within their Point of Sale operations. Standard POS modules typically provide fixed promotional discounts, but they often lack the ability to create customized offers that meet specific business needs. This app bridges that gap by introducing a Custom Discount feature, allowing POS users to create, apply, and track both predefined and custom discounts directly from the POS interface. With this app, administrators can enable the Custom Discount option from the Odoo backend under the POS settings. Once activated, the POS interface will display a dedicated “Custom Discount” button, alongside any existing discount schemes like seasonal promotions (e.g., “Christmas Offer”) or store milestones (e.g., “Shop 6-Year Completion”). This empowers cashiers or sales staff to either apply predefined discounts to selected order lines or the entire order, or create new custom discounts instantly during checkout. The process is straightforward: after selecting products in the POS cart, the cashier can open the discount dialog to choose from available offers or click on the Custom Discount button to create a new one. The system prompts the user to enter a discount percentage and a reason, ensuring that every custom discount is not only applied correctly but also documented for transparency. Discounts can be applied to individual items (Selected Line) or the entire order (All Line). This ensures maximum flexibility, whether the business wants to promote specific products or reward loyal customers with special order-wide deals. name: Website Product and Category Visibility for Customer and Guest Users
description:
The Odoo Website Product and Category Visibility module (compatible with Odoo V11 to V18) allows admins to manage the visibility of products and categories for both guest users and registered customers. This module provides full control over what different types of users can see on the website, ensuring a customized browsing experience.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Guest User Product and Category Visibility:**  
       - Admins can define which products and categories are visible to guest users.  

    2) **Registered Customer Product and Category Visibility:**  
       - Control product and category access for logged-in customers based on user-specific configurations.  

    3) **Dynamic Website Filtering:**  
       - Adjust product listings dynamically depending on the user type.  

    4) **B2B and Membership-Based Access Control:**  
       - Restrict product visibility based on user roles, membership levels, or customer groups.  

    5) **Secure Online Shopping Experience:**  
       - Prevent unauthorized access to restricted products and categories.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Exclusive B2B Products:** Hide wholesale products from retail customers.  
    - **Membership-Based Stores:** Display premium products only to subscribed members.  
    - **Guest User Restrictions:** Limit the visibility of certain products to logged-in customers only.  
    - **Role-Based Shopping:** Show different product categories to different customer groups.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Configuration → Public Guest Visibility  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Configuration → Registered Customer Visibility  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Ecommerce → Products
summary: The Odoo Website Product and Category Visibility module enables administrators to control product and category visibility for both guest users and registered customers. This functionality ensures that only authorized users can access specific products and categories, allowing for a customized browsing experience. With this module, admins can restrict or allow product visibility based on user type, offering a more personalized and secure online store experience. name: Product Multiple Website
description:
The Product Multi Website module enhances Odoo's eCommerce capabilities by allowing businesses to assign multiple websites to a single product. This overcomes the default limitation of selecting only one website per product and improves control over product visibility. Products will only be displayed on selected websites, and the module introduces a customized field to assign multiple websites easily. Additionally, a mass update option lets users assign websites to multiple products simultaneously, saving time and improving productivity.  


    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Select Multiple Websites for Products:**  
       - Products can be assigned to more than one website, providing flexibility in managing product listings across multiple platforms.  

    2) **Mass Update for Multiple Products:**  
       - Quickly update the websites for a large number of products, improving efficiency.  

    3) **Control Product Visibility on Websites:**  
       - Products are displayed only on selected websites. If no websites are selected, they will be shown by default.  

    4) **Custom Website Field:**  
       - A custom field replaces the default website field, enabling multiple website selections for each product.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Multi-Website eCommerce:** Manage products across multiple websites to expand your online presence.  
    - **Product Visibility Control:** Limit product visibility to specific websites or channels based on sales strategies.  
    - **Bulk Product Management:** Quickly update and assign products to multiple websites without manual adjustments.  
    - **eCommerce Catalog Management:** Efficiently manage product listings across various eCommerce platforms.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Product → Sales → Websites (Select multiple websites for a product)  
    - **Navigation:** Product → Settings → Websites (View assigned websites for the product)  
    - **Navigation:** Products → Mass Update (Bulk update website assignments for products)

name: Product Sequence / Index for Point of Screen
description: you can take full control over how products are displayed in your Point of Sale. Each product can be given a unique POS Sequence Number, ensuring that important or frequently sold items always appear exactly where you want them.
summary: This app will allow users to configure the sequence of products and based on that sequence product will be loaded to the Point of Sale screen. This way the sales team can decide which needs to be shown at first and which needs to be shown at last. The POS Product Sequence module is designed to give you full control over how products are displayed in your Odoo Point of Sale. By default, Odoo lists products without any specific order, which can make the POS screen cluttered and harder to use when dealing with many items. This app solves that problem by allowing you to assign a custom sequence number to each product, so you can decide exactly where it should appear in the POS interface. Once enabled from the POS settings, every product gains a Product Sequence field under the Point of Sale tab. You can assign a number like “1” for the first position, “2” for the second, and so on. Products with sequence numbers are shown in order, while those left at “0” are automatically pushed to the bottom. This ensures your best-selling or frequently used products always appear at the top, saving time and making checkout faster. name: Employee Checklist
description:
Employee Checklist
    ==================

    This module provides a robust onboarding tracker for employees, showcasing their progress as a percentage. The checklist functionality allows HR or managers to set up and monitor specific tasks that need to be completed during an employee's entry process.

    - Configurable Checklist:
      Define and customize onboarding tasks under Employee > Configurations.

    - Progress Tracking:
      Real-time tracking of onboarding progress using a percentage progress bar.

    - Multi-View Support:
      Display progress in Form, Tree, and Kanban views for a comprehensive overview.

    Navigation Highlights:
    - **Checklist Configuration**:
      Set up onboarding tasks under Employee ➡ Configurations.

    - **Form View**:
      Verify tasks in the employee checklist, with progress reflected as a percentage and progress bar.

    - **Tree View**:
      View checklist progress in list format with a progress bar for each employee.

    - **Kanban View**:
      Visualize employee onboarding progress in a Kanban-style layout with a progress bar.
